messages:
Connor (sales): Heads-up — SolsticeHealth raised an exec escalation. CFO wants a TCO breakdown + clear path to a 2-week POC. They also flagged: strict data residency in eu-west-1, signed DPA w/ key-escrow, and a pricing cap. Need owners and ETA.
Maya (AE): I already scheduled a CTO sync for tomorrow 11:30 CET. Need a one-pager for execs: scope, risks, and ask (commitment/discount).
Diego (eng-ops): Data residency: we can deploy private in eu-west-1. Lead time depends on whether they want hosted private (fast) vs on-prem (long). Estimate for private in our eu-region: 72h after access and CIDR.
Lena (security): DPA + key escrow question: their legal wants a clause we don't typically accept for hosted. If they insist it forces private install. I'll run the requested clause through counsel; ETA 48h. Need exec sign-off note to prioritize.
Sam (solutions): POC scope clarification: they want 4 vCPU per replica, 2 replicas, and 1 GPU (80GB) for the model. If they push larger traffic we'll need autoscale + larger GPUs. Also they want per-request audit IDs forwarded to Splunk.
Arjun (finance): TCO ask: I can produce a 12-month TCO comparing hosted vs dedicated vs private. Need committed qps/tokens and expected concurrency. Maya please confirm numbers.
Maya (AE): They promised preliminary usage: 500k tokens/mo during POC, ramp to 2M tokens/mo in prod. Concurrency: expected steady 10 qps.
Diego (eng-ops): With those numbers, recommended POC infra: 1x 4-GPU pod (shared), 2 replicas for HA. Peering prep list: customer account ID, VPC CIDR, BGP details optional.
Connor (sales): Pricing / cap — CFO asked us not to exceed $Y/mo (redacted). Can we do a short-term promo to fit under that?
Sam (solutions): Short-term promo suggestion: 4-week POC at flat $Z + standard onboarding + 25% credit toward first committed month. If they want lower, require a letter of intent for production commit.
Arjun (finance): Agree with promo but must include a clear transition plan to committed pricing after POC. I'll draft the numbers and include ARR impact.
Lena (security): Also: need to answer security questionnaire Q4 (encryption at rest), Q11 (access reviews), Q18 (incident response). I'll upload a redacted SOC2 package and answers by EOD.
deploy-bot: peering-request 2087654321 created — status: awaiting inputs (CIDR, account-id).
Diego (eng-ops): Ops risk: if they request cert rotation every 7 days for OIDC assertions that's non-standard. We can do it on private, but hosted needs more wiring.
Maya (AE): Owners: Maya = exec one-pager + schedule; Diego = ops provisioning + peering; Lena = DPA + sec questionnaire; Sam = POC scope + technical caveats; Arjun = TCO/pricing.
Connor (sales): Deadline: I need the one-pager + TCO by 09:00 PT tomorrow for the CIO call. Can folks confirm?
Diego (eng-ops): Confirmed for peering checklist; CIDR must come from customer by EOD today for 72h target.
Lena (security): Confirmed — DPA first pass in 48h, sec artifacts EOD. Can expedite with exec email to legal.
Sam (solutions): I'll attach a short tech appendix with exact replica sizing and expected latencies; ready by EOD.
Arjun (finance): I'll post the TCO doc link here when ready: https://finance.internal/tco/solstice-2087654321 (draft).
Maya (AE): Draft one-pager posted: https://docs.internal/sales/solstice-exec-one-pager (will iterate).
Connor (sales): I'll wait for final one-pager then send to CIO at 09:05 PT. If we get signed DPA + CIDR quickly we can hit 10/14 as POC start.
Diego (eng-ops): Note: maintenance window required for private deploy; customer must approve a 2-hour window.
Lena (security): Final note: If they insist on hosted + key-escrow we escalate legal/pricing; likely outcome = private-only or a negotiated escrow alternative.
Connor (sales): Thanks team. Keep updates here — this thread will be referenced in the exec sync.
